body.en: Security across the full lifecycle of systems, from requirements and design through implementation, deployment, operation, maintenance, and retirement.
body.zh: 覆盖系统从需求、设计、实现、部署、运行、维护到退役的完整生命周期安全。

title.en: Cybersecurity LLMs, AI agents, and benchmarks
title.zh: 网安大模型、AI 智能体与基准

body.en: Build cyber models, study AI agents that operate on complex systems, and develop benchmarks for measuring their capabilities and limitations.
body.zh: 构建网络空间模型，研究运行于复杂系统之上的 AI 智能体，并建立衡量其能力与局限的基准。

body.en: Study how scientific knowledge is produced, evaluated, organized, and made more reproducible and useful.
body.zh: 研究科学知识如何产生、评估、组织，并变得更加可复现和有用。
